label: Attio
agentGuide: Base path /v2. Workspace: GET /self. Objects: GET /objects (people, companies, deals…); attributes of one: GET /objects/<slug>/attributes. Records: POST /objects/<slug>/records/query {"limit": 20, "filter": {"name": {"$contains": "..."}}} (data[].values: each attribute is a list of values, read [0].value or [0].email_address / .full_name); one: GET /objects/<slug>/records/<id>. Create: POST /objects/people/records {"data": {"values": {"email_addresses": ["..."], "name": [{"first_name": "...", "last_name": "..."}]}}}; update: PATCH /objects/<slug>/records/<id> {"data": {"values": {...}}}; assert by email: PUT /objects/people/records?matching_attribute=email_addresses. Lists: GET /lists, entries: POST /lists/<id>/entries/query; notes: GET /notes?parent_object=people&parent_record_id=<id>, add: POST /notes {"data": {"parent_object": "people", "parent_record_id": "...", "title": "...", "format": "plaintext", "content": "..."}}; tasks: POST /tasks. The token is set by Allkin.
